summary: ICL Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.05811 per share, totaling about $75 million, declared by its Board on August 4, 2026. The record date is September 2, 2026, and payment is on September 16, 2026. Shareholders may receive payment in NIS, with the per-share amount subject to exchange-rate changes. Various Israeli withholding tax rates apply. This is a routine dividend declaration with no special-situation elements such as a capital return program or tender offer. The filing is an ordinary current report and does not warrant a special-situations classification. What to watch: no unusual corporate action; simply monitor future dividend declarations.
